title: Father and Son (miniquest)
start: Talk to Irwinsson, located on Anachronia, found south of the Anachronia lodestone.

recommended.t: Enchanted lyre for quick teleport to Rellekka

rewards.l: Medium Hunter XP lamp (Father and Son)

steps.t: Talk to Irwinsson. [Chat: 1 Tell me more about yourself. › Accept]
Talk to Sigli the Huntsman located at the main gate of Rellekka.
Head back to Anachronia and give Irwinsson his greatbow. [Chat: 1 Talk about Sigli.]

get_inside.text: Travelling to Anachronia for the first time requires the player to use The Stormbreaker, the ship built during the Breaking the Storm event, which is located east of the Varrock Dig Site (). Players can board the ship, located on the river, to visit Anachronia. Players will be shown a cutscene the first time they travel to the island and will have to guide a group of NPCs, including an archaeologist, Laniakea, and two guards, through the island.
Map of routes around Anachronia
Agility course

The primary means of travel across the island is traversing the Anachronia Agility Course. This requires Agility levels 30 to 85 to traverse. The course is divided into seven sections of varying difficulty but requires level 85 Agility to complete the whole lap.
Teleports
Quick methods to teleport across the island are ():
Anachronia lodestone, which can be unlocked using materials after completing a tutorial with Giles at the base camp
Slayer cape to teleport to Laniakea's at the south-east ruins
North-western Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the north-western side of Anachronia, near the time altar
Eastern Anachronia Teleport spell to teleport to the eastern side of Anachronia, a short distance to the east of the spirit grove
Anachronia Teleport spell if a Totem of the Abyss is planted and active
Anachronia tablet to teleport to the Player Lodge; it requires the Love Story quest and a tier 2 Player Lodge
Ancient seed to Herby Werby
Mystical tree in two steps: Manor Farm to Anachronia Dinosaur Farm (or Anachronia Dinosaur Farm teleport) and then run south-east; use a tree again to reach the west coast of Anachronia
Dig sites map, master archaeologist's outfit or Archaeology teleport to Orthen Dig Site (or to Sharrigan) with 90 Archaeology
pic: Orthen teleportation device locations in Orthen Dig Site

get_inside.text: Archaeology journal then run east to the Stormbreaker ship
Orthen teleportation device
Players with at least level 90 Archaeology can unlock the Orthen Dig Site and activate the Orthen teleportation devices, allowing them to teleport to four locations across the island:
Crypt of Varanus, located near the arcane apoterrasaur hunting area
Observation outpost, located north of the pavosaurus rex hunting area
Moksha ritual site, located just east of the scimitops hunting area
Xolo city, located within the Anachronia Swamp Fortress on the south-eastern tip of the island
